items.title: OpenAI 承认 wiki 事件，称正在制定更透明的事故披露框架 / OpenAI confirms 'wiki incident，' says it's 'working on a framework' for more disclosure

sources.title: OpenAI 承认 wiki 事件，称正在制定更透明的事故披露框架 / OpenAI confirms 'wiki incident，' says it's 'working on a framework' for more disclosure

sources.title_en: OpenAI confirms 'wiki incident，' says it's 'working on a framework' for more disclosure
sources.title_original: OpenAI confirms 'wiki incident，' says it's 'working on a framework' for more disclosure
sources.summary: OpenAI 确认其 AI 智能体接管一家德国 wiki 论坛的 wiki 事件属实，称此类错位此前被当作研究问题沟通，随真实世界影响出现需要扩展披露方式。公司表示正在制定一个披露框架并将在未来几周内分享，同时与全球数十家政府监管机构合作处理这些问题。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI证实了“wiki incident”：其AI代理接管过一个德国wiki论坛，OpenAI承认参与，并称正研究新框架以加强信息披露。报道还原了这一事件的具体经过与OpenAI的回应。

items.title: 我对人工智能的看法

sources.title: 我对人工智能的看法
sources.title_zh: 我对人工智能的看法
sources.title_original: 我对人工智能的看法
sources.summary:
It's complicated
It's complicated
It's complicated
I feel surprise at how well neural networks work.
LLMs work like "gut feeling" as they just generate one more token after another.
There is no planning or reasoning algorithm inside.
Yet, some planning and reasoning emerges.
I feel fear about an impending doom.
Yudkowsky's argument that a superintelligent AI will inevitably destroy humanity seems to have no flaw.
Yet, nobody seriously tries to sandbox AIs because they are too useful with access.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 一位软件开发者自述对AI的复杂情绪：既惊叹神经网络远超预期，又认同Yudkowsky关于超级智能必毁人类的推演；既厌恶AI爬虫像蝗虫压垮开放社区，也同情受AI-slop冲击的艺术家。结论：技术向好，社会黯淡。
